sections.section_name: Section A - Objective Type / MCQs / Assertion-Reasoning

questions.question_text: Which mode of heat transfer can occur through a complete vacuum without requiring any physical material medium?
questions.answer: C) Radiation

questions.question_text: What specific device is installed on a vehicle's dashboard to measure and record the total distance it has traveled?
questions.answer: B) Odometer

questions.question_text: What is the biological name for the numerous finger-like projections present on the inner walls of the small intestine that increase surface area for absorption?
questions.answer: C) Villi

questions.question_text: In a plant's leaf structure, the tiny pores called stomata are immediately surrounded and controlled by which specialized cells?
questions.answer: B) Guard cells

questions.question_text: What is the optical phenomenon called when a beam of white light passes through a glass prism and splits into a spectrum of seven colors?
questions.answer: C) Dispersion

questions.question_text: During which specific lunar phase does a Solar Eclipse visibly occur from Earth?
questions.answer: B) New Moon day

questions.question_text: During a daytime sea breeze, in which direction do the localized convection air currents primarily blow?
options: A) From the sea towards the land
B) From the land towards the sea
C) Vertically upwards from the sea only
D) Downwards from the clouds to the land
questions.answer: A) From the sea towards the land

questions.question_text: What is the standard International System (SI) unit used worldwide for measuring time?
questions.answer: C) Second

questions.question_text: Animals like cows and buffaloes that quickly swallow their food and later bring it back to chew are scientifically classified as:
questions.answer: B) Ruminants

questions.question_text: Which continuous vascular tissue is specifically responsible for transporting water and dissolved minerals from plant roots to leaves?
questions.answer: B) Xylem

questions.question_text: What are the universal characteristics of the optical image formed by a standard convex spherical mirror?
options: C) Real, erect, and same size
questions.answer: B) Virtual, erect, and diminished

questions.question_text: A Lunar Eclipse can only take place when the Earth aligns precisely between the Sun and the Moon during a:
questions.answer: A) Full Moon

questions.question_text: Why do people conventionally prefer wearing dark-colored clothing during cold winter seasons?
options: A) Dark colors reflect all thermal radiation.
B) Dark colors are better absorbers of heat radiation.
C) Dark colors produce internal heat chemically.
D) Dark colors reduce body weight.
questions.answer: B) Dark colors are better absorbers of heat radiation.

questions.question_text: How does the distance-time graph appear for an object moving along a straight path at a constant, uniform speed?
questions.answer: C) A straight diagonal line

questions.question_text: In the human mouth, what specific component does salivary amylase begin to chemically break down during digestion?
questions.answer: C) Starch into simple sugars

questions.question_text: When parallel light rays strike a highly polished, smooth surface like a mirror, the resulting reflection is termed as:
questions.answer: C) Regular reflection

questions.question_text:
Given below are two statements labeled as Assertion (A) and Reason (R):
Assertion (A): Cooking pans are generally fitted with wooden or plastic handles.
Reason (R): Wood and plastic are excellent insulators that do not conduct heat efficiently.
Choose the correct option:
options: A) Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A.
B) Both A and R are true but R is NOT the correct explanation of A.
C) A is true but R is false.
D) A is false but R is true.
questions.answer: A) Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A.

questions.question_text:
Given below are two statements labeled as Assertion (A) and Reason (R):
Assertion (A): An odometer is an instrument strictly used to measure the instantaneous speed of a running vehicle.
Reason (R): A speedometer accurately records the total distance traveled by the vehicle over time.
Choose the correct option:
options: A) Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A.
B) Both A and R are true but R is NOT the correct explanation of A.
C) A is true but R is false.
D) Both A and R are false.
questions.answer: D) Both A and R are false.

questions.question_text:
Given below are two statements labeled as Assertion (A) and Reason (R):
Assertion (A): Plants require a constant supply of oxygen gas from the air to perform photosynthesis.
Reason (R): Oxygen gas is a vital raw material absorbed through roots for synthesizing plant food.
Choose the correct option:
options: A) Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A.
B) Both A and R are true but R is NOT the correct explanation of A.
C) A is true but R is false.
D) Both A and R are false.
questions.answer: D) Both A and R are false.

questions.question_text:
Given below are two statements labeled as Assertion (A) and Reason (R):
Assertion (A): A standard plane mirror always forms a laterally inverted image of an object.
Reason (R): In a laterally inverted image, the left side of the physical object appears as the right side on the mirror surface.
Choose the correct option:
options: A) Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A.
B) Both A and R are true but R is NOT the correct explanation of A.
C) A is true but R is false.
D) A is false but R is true.
questions.answer: A) Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A.

questions.question_text: Why are building ventilators almost always placed high up near the ceiling of a room? [20-30 words]
questions.answer: Warm air is lighter and rises upwards, exiting through ventilators. Cool, fresh air enters through lower windows, setting up convection currents for effective ventilation.

questions.question_text: A car travels 90 km in 1.5 hours. Calculate its average speed in meters per second (m/s). [20-30 words]
questions.answer: Speed is distance over time: 90 km divided by 1.5 hours equals 60 km/h. To convert to m/s, multiply by 5/18, giving approximately 16.67 m/s.

questions.question_text: What is the primary physiological function of the large intestine in the human digestive system? [20-30 words]
questions.answer: The main function of the large intestine is to absorb vital water and dissolved mineral salts from the remaining undigested food material before eliminating it.

questions.question_text: Define the biological term 'transpiration' in plants and state one major functional benefit it provides. [20-30 words]
questions.answer: Transpiration is the evaporative loss of water vapor from leaf stomata. It generates a suction pull for drawing up root water and physically cools the plant.

questions.question_text: Differentiate clearly between a luminous and a non-luminous object with one accurate example of each. [20-30 words]
questions.answer: Luminous objects, like the Sun, emit their own natural light. Non-luminous objects, like the Moon, do not produce light but simply reflect light from other sources.

questions.question_text: Briefly explain why observers on Earth permanently see only one specific face of the Moon. [20-30 words]
questions.answer: The Moon's period of rotation on its axis takes exactly the same time as its orbital revolution around Earth, keeping one face permanently turned away.

questions.question_text: Explain the precise thermal mechanism of a sea breeze occurring in coastal regions during the day. [30-40 words]
questions.answer: During the day, land heats up faster than water. The air above land warms, expands, and rises, creating low pressure. Cooler, denser air from the sea rushes in to fill this space, creating a cooling sea breeze.

questions.question_text: Describe the appearance of a distance-time graph for uniform motion and explain what its gradient indicates. [30-40 words]
questions.answer: For uniform motion, a distance-time graph appears as a perfectly straight line originating from the zero axis and sloping diagonally upwards. This constant gradient indicates the object covers absolutely equal distances in perfectly equal time intervals.

questions.question_text: How does a microscopic Amoeba successfully ingest and subsequently digest its food particles in water? [30-40 words]
questions.answer: An Amoeba pushes out temporary finger-like projections called pseudopodia to encircle and engulf food particles, forming a food vacuole. Digestive juices are then secreted directly into this vacuole to break down the food into simpler absorbable substances.

questions.question_text: Contrast the respective structural functions of xylem and phloem tissues within a mature vascular plant. [30-40 words]
questions.answer: Xylem acts as a unidirectional pipeline, transporting water and dissolved minerals from the root system upwards to the leaves. Phloem is a bidirectional tissue, distributing the synthesized sugars from the leaves to all growing parts of the plant.

questions.question_text: State three specific, invariable characteristics of the optical image formed by a standard flat plane mirror. [30-40 words]
questions.answer: An image formed by a plane mirror is always virtual, strictly erect (upright), and laterally inverted. Furthermore, it is exactly the same size as the object and forms at an equal distance behind the mirror surface.

questions.question_text: Distinguish clearly between the relative planetary positions of celestial bodies during a solar eclipse versus a lunar eclipse. [30-40 words]
questions.answer: During a solar eclipse, the Moon moves exactly between the Earth and the Sun, blocking solar light. Conversely, during a lunar eclipse, the Earth aligns precisely between the Sun and the Moon, casting its planetary shadow onto the lunar surface.

questions.question_text: Why is it absolutely necessary that a clinical thermometer be jerked firmly before measuring a new patient's body temperature? [30-40 words]
questions.answer: A clinical thermometer features a narrow kink near the bulb that prevents mercury from falling back automatically. Jerking it firmly forces the expanded mercury thread back into the bulb, resetting the scale to read a new accurate temperature.

questions.question_text: Describe the specialized digestive process known as rumination in herbivorous farm animals like cows and buffaloes. [30-40 words]
questions.answer: Cows rapidly swallow partially chewed grass, storing it in the rumen where bacteria break down cellulose. Later, this semi-digested food, called cud, returns to the mouth in small lumps for thorough chewing, a complex process termed rumination.

questions.question_text: A student sets up an experiment placing a potted plant in a completely dark room for 72 hours, then tests its leaves with iodine solution. Explain the biological purpose of the dark phase, the observed result of the iodine test, and the conclusion drawn regarding plant life processes. [50-60 words]
questions.answer: The dark phase completely destarches the plant, as it consumes stored food while photosynthesis ceases without light. When tested with iodine, the leaves remain pale yellow instead of turning blue-black, indicating a total absence of starch. This visually proves that sunlight is a strictly essential requirement for plants to synthesize food.

questions.question_text: Explain the fundamental differences between clinical and laboratory thermometers in terms of their temperature range, specific design features (like the kink), and their designated practical applications in daily life. [50-60 words]
questions.answer: A clinical thermometer has a short range of 35°C to 42°C and features a kink near the bulb to hold the mercury level, making it ideal for measuring human body temperature. A laboratory thermometer lacks this kink and measures a broader range, typically -10°C to 110°C, strictly used for continuous monitoring in scientific chemical experiments.

questions.question_text: Describe the basic internal construction of a pinhole camera device and clearly explain the three fundamental characteristics of the optical image it produces on its translucent viewing screen. [50-60 words]
questions.answer: A pinhole camera consists of a light-proof box with a tiny puncture on one side and a translucent tracing paper screen opposite it. Light rays travel in straight lines, crossing exactly at the pinhole. Consequently, the projected image on the screen is always completely inverted, real (captured on a surface), and significantly smaller than the original object.

questions.question_text: Observe a mechanical pendulum clock swinging continuously. Define its precise time period, explain what physical motion constitutes one complete oscillation, and discuss how changing the mass of the metallic bob affects its operational swinging speed. [50-60 words]
questions.answer: A pendulum's time period is the exact duration required to complete one full oscillation, which means swinging from one extreme position to the other and returning to the initial starting point. Interestingly, the operational swinging speed and time period depend entirely on string length; changing the bob's mass has absolutely zero effect on its timing.
